meta.name: copywriting-refiner
meta.description: Audits any cold email, LinkedIn message, or outreach sequence against a strict quality checklist and rewrites every failing element. Use when asked "refine this email", "clean up my copy", "check this email", "can you review this sequence", "fix my cold email", or whenever outreach copy is shared and needs to be tightened up. Also use when the user pastes an email and asks if it's good, too long, too formal, or "too salesy". Always produces a pass/fail audit + a corrected version of the copy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审核并改写冷邮件和领英消息，提升转化效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常写销售或商务外联文案，需要确保专业有效。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and rewrite cold emails and LinkedIn messages to boost conversion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write sales or business outreach copy and need to ensure it's professional and effective.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动审查你发给潜在客户的邮件或领英消息，对照一个严格的质量清单逐项检查，对每项不合格的内容进行标记，并直接给出修改后的版本。它还能判断格式（第一封邮件、跟进、领英消息等），并按相应规则检查。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化这段文案”、“检查这封邮件”、“修改我的冷邮件”，或询问邮件质量时触发。

say.note: Claude 会输出审计报告和修正版。

say.text: 检查我的领英消息，看看有没有问题
say.note: Claude 会按领英消息规则检查长度、措辞等。
Claude 会检查字数是否超限并给出修改。
